_comment: Field ROIs are in pixels of the reference page, carried over from
pipeline_htr.ipynb (measured with the interactive selector at 300 dpi).
'reference_size' is null because the exact pixel dimensions of that
reference scan were not recorded; set it to [width, height] once you
confirm them, and the loader will warn if a differently-sized page is
used as reference. Better still, run LayoutSpec.to_relative(w, h) once
and save the result: relative coordinates survive a change of scan
grouping); 'postprocess' drives the correction rule and is independent.
